subtitle: In-Context Dexterous Manipulation from a Single Numerical Demonstration

protocol.t10_scoring: Published carton adapter; raw contact forces are diagnostic only. These rates do not establish strict compliance with a 12 N contact-force limit.

interpretation.sample_size: 10 trials per condition per task; observations are descriptive.
interpretation.content_length: Removing demonstration fields changes both semantic information and context length.
interpretation.meta: META retains demonstration instruction, field descriptions, and timestamps; it is not the No Demo condition.
